skill.name: file-organizer
skill.description: Guides scoped local file organization, duplicate review, folder planning, and approved cleanup.
skill.summary: Organize local folders with analysis, duplicate review, and approved cleanup plans.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The skill is a legitimate local file organization guide with no evidence of prompt injection, credential harvesting, network calls, or exfiltration intent. Several shell command examples are real external-command risks because they scan or mutate user-selected directories, but most static hits are Markdown fence false positives.

remediation.suggestion: Quote and validate user-supplied paths. Prefer structured file APIs or argument arrays where the host tool supports them.

remediation.issue: File moves can cause data loss.
remediation.suggestion: Require a dry run, keep a move log, handle conflicts deterministically, and provide rollback steps before changing files.

remediation.issue: Duplicate cleanup can remove valuable files.
remediation.suggestion: Show hashes, paths, sizes, and modification dates. Archive uncertain duplicates before permanent deletion.
Document macOS, Linux, and Windows differences for hashing and file search commands before users run them.

content.value_statement: Cluttered folders hide important files and waste storage. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through scoped analysis, organization plans, and approved cleanup steps.
actual_capabilities: Reviews a target directory structure and summarizes file counts, types, sizes, and date ranges.
Suggests folder groupings by file type, purpose, project, or age.
Finds exact duplicates, similar filenames, and similar-sized files for user review.
Creates an organization plan before changing files.
Guides approved folder creation, file moves, and renaming with logging.
Provides a post-cleanup summary and maintenance tips.
limitations: Requires a clear target directory and permission to inspect it.
Shell examples may need adjustment for macOS, Linux, or Windows.
Duplicate recommendations still need human review before deletion.
Should not scan sensitive folders without explicit scope and safeguards.

use_cases.title: Clean a Downloads folder
use_cases.description: Sort mixed downloads into clear groups, flag duplicates, and keep uncertain files in review.

use_cases.title: Prepare project archives
use_cases.description: Separate active work, reference material, old builds, and archive candidates before storage.

use_cases.title: Standardize shared folders
use_cases.description: Create consistent folder names and cleanup rules for team documents and media.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize my [folder] conservatively. First inspect the structure, then propose a plan. Do not move, rename, or delete anything until I approve.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Downloads
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me clean my Downloads folder. Group files by type and age, identify files that need my decision, and make a reversible plan.

prompt_templates.title: Review Duplicates
prompt_templates.prompt: Find possible duplicates in [folder]. Show exact matches separately from similar names, explain which copy to keep, and wait for confirmation before deleting.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Full Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged organization plan for [folder] with active, archive, reference, and review areas. Include a dry run, conflict handling, rollback notes, and maintenance steps.

output_examples.input: Review my Downloads folder and propose a conservative plan.
output_examples.output: A summary of file types, largest folders, duplicate candidates, and a proposed structure with an approval checkpoint.

output_examples.input: Organize this old project for archival.
output: Active files separated from archive candidates.
Folders grouped by documents, media, source material, and review items.
A change summary that lists every approved move.

output_examples.input: Find duplicate photos without deleting anything.
output_examples.output: A duplicate review grouped by exact matches and similar names, with recommended keep choices and manual confirmation steps.

best_practices: Start with one target directory and exclude sensitive or active project folders.
Request a dry run, move log, and confirmation checkpoint before changes.
Archive uncertain files before deleting them permanently.
anti_patterns: Running organization commands across an entire home directory without scope limits.
Deleting duplicate candidates based only on filename similarity.
Moving files before reviewing conflicts, permissions, and rollback steps.

faq.question: Can this skill delete files?
faq.answer: It can recommend deletion, but it should ask for approval before any deletion. Archive uncertain files first.

faq.question: Does it work on every operating system?
faq.answer: The guidance is shell-oriented. Some commands need adjustment for each platform, especially hashing and file search options.

faq.question: Can it organize sensitive data?
faq.answer: Use a narrow scope and review plans carefully. Do not scan folders that contain secrets unless required.

faq.question: Will it find all duplicates?
faq.answer: It can find exact matches and likely duplicates. Similar files still require human review.

faq.question: Can it undo changes?
faq.answer: Only if you request logging or rollback steps before execution. Ask for a dry run and move log.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is written for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.
